segments.sn40.8:1.4: ‘idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn40.8:1.6: So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn40.8:1.7: Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato ākiñcaññāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
segments.sn40.8:2.1: “Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca –
segments.sn40.8:2.3: Mā, brāhmaṇa, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pamādo, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ samādahā’ti.
segments.sn40.8:2.4: So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
segments.sn40.8:2.5: Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya … pe … mahābhiññataṃ patto”ti.

lines: Tassa hi paṭhamajjhānavuṭṭhitassa pañca nīvaraṇāni santato upaṭṭhahiṃsu.
Tenassa taṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ hānabhāgiyaṃ nāma ahosi.
Taṃ pamādaṃ ñatvā satthā “mā pamādo”ti ovādaṃ adāsi.
332-339. Kāmasahagatesu saññāmanasikāresu upaṭṭhahantesu byāpādādisahagatāpi saññāmanasikārā yathāpaccayaṃ upaṭṭhahantiyevāti vuttaṃ “kāmasahagatāti pañcanīvaraṇasahagatā”ti.
Pahīnāvasesā cettha nīvaraṇā veditabbā, tasmā pañcaggahaṇaṃ na kattabbaṃ.
